title: けやき通りの四つの手がかり

scenes.title: Twenty Paces East
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on Keyaki Street, F1, M2, and M3 check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: By the Stone Fountain
scenes.summary: At the neighbourhood stone fountain, F1 and M3 spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but M2 insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: The Famous Shortcut
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, M2 leads the group straight back outside F2's open café kitchen window at Hidamari Inn.

scenes.title: Shadow of the Clock Tower
scenes.summary: Joined by M4 at the municipal clock tower at noon, F1 and M3 watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: Under the Bookshop Arch
scenes.summary: Meeting F3 under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, F1 spots the green lending shelf in Card Three—making F3 gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: The Shaded Park Bench
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of Keyaki Street, M3 places all four square cards together to reveal a bird's-eye map of Hidamari Inn with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: Opening the Small Envelope
scenes.summary: On the park bench, F1, F3, and M3 break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: Message at the Front Desk
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, F1 and M2 find M1 holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
